response.rationale: The champion, R2, is supported by the patient's symptoms of lower extremity swelling, erythema, and hyperpigmentation, as well as the results of the venous reflux study. The runner-up, R4, is supported by the patient's presentation of erythematous, ill-defined, and extremely tender plaques on the lower extremities, but lacks explicit evidence of chronic venous insufficiency.

rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and history do not strongly support radiation-induced dermatitis as the primary diagnosis.
While the patient has moderate peripheral arterial disease, the symptoms and imaging findings are more consistent with chronic venous insufficiency.
This candidate is an append-only completion of R4 and does not provide sufficient additional evidence to support it as the champion.
